ordinary_repository_test_results.interpretation: Author regressions pass but do not cover the independent blocking cases.

discrepancies.finding: Relation admission treats syntactically shaped generation references and any non-empty source_relation_ref string as exact owner evidence. Wrong/stale generations, relabelled machine provenance and contradictory owner evidence can cross ADMITTED_SOURCE_EXPLICIT.
ResearchDemand validates question shape but not exact owner existence/currentness/status, so a stale or invented question generation is accepted.
The query engine does not validate generation/currentness/frontier/history coherence and does not surface exact ambiguity/conflict records in RELATIONS.
RESTRICTED visibility still returns owner-linked entries, and CROSS_MODE returns relations without exact exposure evidence.
GET_THEORY returns an internal mutable entry by reference; a caller can mutate the engine's held state through a read-only query result.

decision_rationale: Two declared matrix obligations and thirteen fresh adversarial obligations fail deterministically. The failures permit unverified or stale owner semantics to auto-admit, suppress ambiguity/conflict evidence, leak restricted or exposure-unbound query data, and mutate held query state. Passing author tests and VIT/SIQ/GRT integration receipts do not cure these semantic defects.

scope: Bind relation generation refs and source-explicit admission to exact owner-source/currentness resolution; reject wrong, stale, opaque, relabelled-machine and conflicting owner evidence.
Bind ResearchDemand question refs to exact owner existence/currentness/status and fail closed on stale or superseded questions.
Validate generation/currentness/frontier/history coherence before query execution and surface ambiguity/conflict records explicitly.
Enforce visibility and cross-mode exposure evidence at query output boundaries and return detached immutable/deep-copied result data.

rollback_route: Preserve the WP4 merge, consolidated commission and this BLOCK packet unchanged. Implement only P2CTII-WP4-REMEDIATION-1 on a separate bounded lane from then-current lawful main; integrate through current VIT/SIQ/GRT; then commission a new conflict-free independent P2CTII-G4-ALG review.
